# Kirill Lebedev, PhD
> Director of Engineering | AI & Ads Measurement Leader

Kirill Lebedev, PhD is a technology executive based in SF Bay Area.
He leads engineering organizations across artificial intelligence, distributed systems, and advertising technology.

## Core Executive Highlights
- Current Role: Director of Engineering at LinkedIn (Overall Ads Measurement Leader).
- Leadership Scope: 40-70+ person full-stack engineering organization across Audience, Identity, Incrementality, Recommendations, and Measurement.
- Commercial Scale: Bootstrapped LinkedIn's Brand Advertising business line to over $1B+ in annual revenue (~20% of total ad revenue).
- AI Growth: Served as Engineering DRI for AI Ads Audience products, accelerating revenue 6x to $100M+ ARR in six months.
- Institutional Governance: Multi-year company-wide hiring committee member; technical representative in corporate M&A.
- Incrementality Coverage: 25% of total advertising revenue covered by incremental measurement with 2x incremental spend lift.
- Issued US Patents: 
  - US 11,968,185: Dynamically altering the display of elements on client devices
  - US 11,232,254: Dynamic distribution of content on client devices
  - US 11,102,534: Dynamic asset delivery and local runtime evaluation
- Academic Credentials: PhD in Computer Science (Model-Driven Architecture & dynamic metadata persistence); Summa cum laude in Systems Engineering & Low-Level System/Software Design; former university Professor and Deputy Vice-Rector.
- Location: SF Bay Area
- Phone: +1 (415) 799-9995

## Career Roles
- Director of Engineering & Overall Ads Measurement Leader — LinkedIn (2018 – Present)
- Senior Engineering Manager / Architect — Apple Cloud Services (2016 – 2018)
- Head of Core Platform Engineering — Playtika (2013 – 2016)
- Chief Technology Officer — i.Point (2007 – 2013)
- Professor & Deputy Vice-Rector — Irkutsk National Research Technical University (2002 – 2007)

## Core Technical Doctrines
1. Bayesian Causal Inference & Account-Based Marketing: Isolate selection bias from true ad intervention using Bayesian incrementality and company-level audience splits.
2. Differential Privacy & Privacy-Safe Signal Consolidation: Unify Conversions API (CAPI) with cryptographic compute and differential privacy noise reduction.
3. Scaled Identity Graph & Pairwise Multi-Source Resolution: Ingest and resolve pairwise observations from 1st-party platform signals and 3rd-party data providers at scale.
